title: Project Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Project Coordinator
Location: South Africa
Job Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)
Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)
We are looking for a highly organised Project Coordinator who can keep multiple moving parts on track in a busy, fast-changing environment. You will manage permit follow-ups, scheduling, invoicing and workflow coordination while communicating regularly with building departments and customers.
This role is less about having a specific title or qualification and more about having a natural talent for coordination. You should be able to juggle priorities, pivot quickly, follow through consistently and maintain accuracy under pressure.
Key responsibilities

• Follow up on permits and coordinate with relevant building departments.

• Schedule and confirm customer appointments.

• Manage invoicing and support accurate administrative processing.

• Monitor workflows, track outstanding actions and keep projects moving forward.

• Communicate confidently and professionally with customers and external departments by phone.

• Reprioritise tasks as circumstances change and ensure urgent matters are handled promptly.

• Double-check information and completed work before submitting it.

• Use team communication channels effectively, including responding to tagged tasks and taking clear ownership of assigned actions.

Requirements

• Excellent spoken English with clear, neutral and easy-to-understand phone communication.

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of competing priorities.

• A proactive approach, with the confidence to follow up and keep tasks moving.

• Excellent attention to detail and a habit of checking work carefully.

• The ability to remain calm, constructive and professional in a direct, fast-paced environment.

• Strong written communication skills.

• Comfort learning new systems and processes. No specific software experience is required.

You do not need to have held the title of Project Coordinator. We welcome candidates with strong transferable experience, including:

• Construction, permitting or a related operational environment.

• A high-volume or similar fast-paced setting.

• Constant juggling, structured coordination and quick changes in direction.

• Customer service, scheduling, administration or workflow management.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.
Let us walk you through the next steps.
Step 1 - Complete Your Application
Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.
Step 2 - The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)
This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!
Why do we ask for a video?
Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you . Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

• How you communicate and connect with people.

• How you present yourself professionally.

• Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.
Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel-make it count!
Step 3 - Let's Actually Talk
A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff - payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR - so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) - because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

You’ll be a key engineer focused on building and owning the systems that move money and assets through Gusto Retirement. This is a very hands-on role: owning backend services and APIs end-to-end, shipping production code, and working through real financial edge cases. You’ll partner closely with product, compliance, and operations to turn complex financial requirements into reliable software. If you like working on core systems where correctness matters and enjoy getting things shipped, you’ll be a great fit.

The Financial Infrastructure team owns the core money and asset flow systems for Gusto Retirement. We’re a senior team that works on payments, settlements, tax and compliance integrations, and much more. • Write clear, reliable, well-tested code that ships quickly and scales well

• Build a product that our customers genuinely love

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 8+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production products or platforms

• Strong experience with services, APIs, and data-heavy workflows.

• Experience working on financial systems, payments, or other high-correctness domains (or the ability to ramp quickly).

• Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, including production support and operational work.

• Experience working closely with PMs and cross-functional partners to deliver scoped work.

• Pragmatic, execution-focused approach to engineering.

• Clear communicator and collaborative teammate.

• Ability to mentor engineers to maximize their performance and impact

• Experience with Ruby on Rails (or a comparable backend framework).

Bonus Points:

• Experience leveraging AI tools or systems to accelerate development, improve testing, and deliver new product capabilities.

• Curiosity and experimentation with emerging AI frameworks, applying and sharing best practices to evaluate and scale AI use safely across teams.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Revenue Accountant to play a critical role on our Technical Revenue Accounting team - a part of our overall Contract to Cash Process. Reporting to the Technical Revenue Accounting Manager, this individual will be responsible for the accurate and timely recognition of revenue across our diverse portfolio of product and service contracts, with a strong emphasis on Product, Subscription (Lease), and Maintenance contracts.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Senior Revenue Accountant will leverage Oracle Fusion Projects to manage the end-to-end project accounting lifecycle, including contract review, fulfillment, cutoff, allocation of revenue according to ASC 606, and evaluating the appropriate revenue recognition model to apply (point-in-time versus over time). This individual will act as a key liaison, bridging the gap between Business Line FP&A teams and Corporate Accounting to ensure financial results accurately reflect project execution and strategy.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

• Work with Technical Accounting to ensure revenue is recognized in accordance with ASC 606 for new and modified customer contracts.
• Perform technical assessments to determine the appropriate timing and method of revenue recognition, with a strong focus on *transfer of control* for both product sales (e.g., shipment, customer acceptance) and service delivery (e.g., over time, milestones).
• Evaluate and determine Standalone Selling Price (SSP) for use in the allocation of contract pricing to performance obligations.
• Provide guidance and support to cross-functional teams on revenue recognition matters, including contract review, revenue forecasting, and deal structuring. This role requires collaboration with Program Managers, Finance Program Analysts, and various other departments.
• Execute revenue close procedures efficiently and accurately within tight monthly, quarterly, and annual deadlines.
• Monitor contract funding, limits, modifications, closeouts, and progress to completion, to ensure accurate revenue recognition.
• Ensure compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and company policies.
• Collaborate with Project Management, Contracts, and Pricing teams to understand contract terms and conditions, and provide guidance on revenue recognition impacts.
• Provide ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting to support strategic decision-making by senior management and FP&A.
• Prepare and review complex revenue journal entries, ensuring proper classification and supporting documentation.
• Look around the corner to mitigate future potential issues and mitigate actual issues with optimized processes and controls.
• Support internal and external audit requests, including DCAA audits, by providing detailed documentation and explanations.
• Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within the revenue accounting cycle to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
• Act as a power user of our ERP system (Oracle Fusion Cloud) for all revenue-related activities, including contract setup, project accounting, product and service pricing, and contract asset / liability accounting.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance

title: Data Center Capacity & Inventory Manager
description:
The Data Center Capacity & Inventory Manager owns a single, accurate, and always-current view of the organization's entire data center estate worldwide. The role exists because the biggest infrastructure decisions - where to place workloads, when to expand or consolidate, and how to plan a move - are only as reliable as the underlying data on power, cooling, racks, and space.
That information is typically fragmented across sites, spreadsheets, and providers. This role consolidates it into one authoritative source of truth, keeps it current, and turns it into capacity forecasts, utilization reporting, and move/migration analysis the business depends on. It is accountable for the inventory and operational data of every facility the organization uses - owned, colocation, and edge.
Scope & Context
• Global portfolio: every data center facility across all regions - company-owned and on-premises sites, colocation and wholesale space, and edge or remote equipment rooms.
• Physical assets: racks and cabinets; power (utility feeds, UPS, generators, PDUs, circuits); cooling (CRAC/CRAH, containment, chilled water); floor, cage, and suite space; structured cabling; and environmental monitoring.
• Data domains: inventory, capacity and utilization, contracts and commitments (colo agreements, power and space reservations), and a history of physical changes.
• Organizational placement: reports into infrastructure/IT leadership and partners with networking, cloud, security, procurement, and finance.
• Key stakeholders: site and facilities teams, colocation providers, infrastructure engineering, capacity planning, finance (cost allocation), and the business units requesting space or moves.
Key Responsibilities
• Define and enforce how every site records and reports its power, cooling, rack, and space configuration, so data is comparable across the portfolio.
• Participate in the the space, power, and cooling analysis behind data center moves, migrations, and consolidations: what fits where, target-site readiness, and the sequencing of each move.
• Supply the accurate capacity and utilization data that drives resourcing and planning decisions
• Manage capacity risk proactively: identify sites approaching power, cooling, or space limits before they constrain the business.
• Uphold resilience, safety, and compliance standards across facilities, including redundancy targets (for example N+1) and disaster-recovery posture.
Inventory, Data & Capacity Management (Core Mandate)
This is the primary purpose of the role: a single, trusted, global source of truth for every data center, kept accurate and current.
Maintain the global inventory and data for all facilities
• A complete register of every data center and equipment room, with location, provider, and contracted commitments.
• Space: floor area, cage and suite allocation, rack and cabinet counts, rack-unit (RU) inventory and occupancy, and remaining white space.
• Power: utility feeds and redundancy, UPS and generator capacity, PDU and circuit inventory, provisioned vs. actual draw (kW) per rack, row, and room, and PUE where measured.
• Cooling: cooling capacity and type, containment, redundancy (N, N+1), temperature and humidity envelopes, and thermal headroom.
• Racks & assets: rack elevations, cabinet layouts, and the physical assets each contains, mapped to their power and connectivity.
Turn that data into decisions
• Track utilization and remaining headroom for space, power, and cooling at rack, row, room, and site level.
• Forecast capacity, flag sites approaching their limits, and recommend expansion, consolidation, or reallocation.
• Provide the analysis behind every move and migration - what a target site can support and how a move should be staged.
• Produce regular reporting and dashboards for leadership, finance, and planning.
Own the tooling and data quality
• Define data standards, naming conventions, and an audit cadence that keep the inventory accurate.
• Run periodic physical audit

This role is designed for someone who wants to transition from advisor or senior operator into a true company-building leadership role , with full P&L responsibility as the business grows.

The individual stepping into this role will help shape the company's strategy, build the team, and scale both the service and technology components of the business.

The Venture Studio Advantage

Trustbridge is incubated within Vulcury , a venture studio that builds and scales companies across technology, manufacturing, and financial services.

Unlike a traditional startup where founders must build every function from scratch, Vulcury provides shared infrastructure including:

• Strategic research and market analysis

• Marketing and growth capabilities

• Operational and financial systems

• Technical development resources

• Access to advisors, investors, and industry partners

This structure allows Trustbridge leadership to focus on building the business itself , while benefiting from shared capabilities designed to accelerate execution.

Engineering & Design Services

Trustbridge provides design-for-manufacturing and product development support that helps companies successfully bring products to production.

This capability allows Trustbridge to build strong relationships with companies launching new products and supporting their manufacturing journey.

Manufacturing Supplier Platform

Trustbridge is building a software platform designed to improve how companies identify and engage qualified manufacturing suppliers.

The platform will help streamline sourcing decisions while connecting capable manufacturers with meaningful production opportunities.

Commercial Strategy

• Develop the go-to-market strategy for both supplier network expansion and customer acquisition

Organizational Development

• Recruit and develop the early leadership team

• Build scalable operational systems

• Prepare the business for future growth and potential capital formation

This role is structured as a co-founder level opportunity.

title: Senior/Lead User Acquisition Manager - Brighterly
locationText: Any of our Offices (Kyiv / Lviv / Warsaw) · Remote
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

SKELAR - це venture builder, який будує міжнародні продуктові IT-компанії за правилами світу венчурних інвестицій. Разом із ко-фаундерами збираємо сильні команди, щоб запускати продуктові IT-бізнеси та перемагати на глобальних ринках.

Зараз ми в пошуку Senior/Lead User Acquisition Manager.

Brighterly - EdTech-бізнес: навчаємо дітей у США математики та читання. Ми будуємо освітню екосистему, щоб стати «домашньою сторінкою» з вивчення шкільних предметів для дітей та їхніх батьків.

Тисячі дітей щодня проходять уроки на нашій платформі. Бізнес зростає втричі рік до року, а ринок визнав наш продукт: Brighterly очолив рейтинг World's EdTech Rising Stars 2026 за версією журналу TIME.

Зараз працюємо з трьома джерелами трафіку: Meta - основне, TikTok та Google - у стадії R&D. Шукаємо Senior/Lead User Acquisition Manager, який візьме на себе зону user acquisition: спершу працюватиме з каналами hands-on, а далі сформує та очолить команду й напрям User Acquisition загалом.

В твою зону відповідальності буде входити:

- Управління та масштабування Meta Ads. Це основний канал трафіку, бюджети на який ростуть щомісяця. Твоє завдання - масштабувати канал, покращуючи ефективність.

- TikTok. Ми вже запустили цей канал, зараз він у стадії R&D, але бачимо позитивну динаміку. Розвитком TikTok уже займається креативний маркетолог, а твоє завдання - взяти на себе user acquisition на цьому сорсі та вивести його на цільові показники.

- Глибока робота з аналітикою: від маркетингових метрик до юніт-економіки та LTV.

- Пошук і тестування нових підходів до залучення користувачів: нетворкінг, відкриті джерела тощо.

- Розвиток автоматизацій для user acquisition. У нас уже є інструмент автоматизації, який закриває частину ручної роботи. Ти зможеш розвивати його, щоб автоматизувати повторювані процеси.

- Побудова процесів і системи ухвалення рішень в User Acquisition. У тебе буде свобода в реалізації ідей.

 

Що для нас важливо:

- 4+ роки в user acquisition / performance-маркетингу

- Досвід масштабування Meta Ads - можеш поділитись кейсом, як виростив(ла) канал і що відбувалося з ефективністю.

- Don't settle for mediocrity: ти не задовольняєшся посереднім результатом, завжди шукаєш, як досягти кращого, і ставиш під сумнів поточні підходи.

- Досвід роботи з TikTok Ads, Google або іншими джерелами трафіку буде плюсом

- Досвід найму та управління командою буде плюсом.

 

Що пропонуємо

- Зону відповідальності з великим впливом на бізнес: user acquisition - один із ключових драйверів росту компанії.

- Можливість стати лідером ключового напряму та побудувати команду в бізнесі, який пройшов «долину смерті» й масштабується.

- Бюджети, які ростуть, і свободу тестувати нові канали та підходи.

Шукаємо людину, яка вже масштабувала paid-канали і хоче взяти на себе user acquisition у швидкозростаючому стартапі з world-class продуктом - спочатку руками, далі з командою.

Окрім бізнесів, ми маємо Благодійний фонд SKELAR, який допомагає із забезпеченням українських захисників та захисниць амуніцією та технікою, а також підтримує зовнішні military-проєкти.

SKELAR - середовище для самореалізації людей, які здатні створити успішні компанії. Ми такі компанії називаємо the next big everything. Віримо в їх потужність та масштаб.

Ми плануємо й надалі розвивати tech-бізнеси, підкорювати глобальні ринки та працювати задля перемоги України 🇺🇦

Для цього створили всі можливості всередині нашого venture builder’a:

- 8 інфраструктурних команд, які допомагають стартапам закривати будь-які питання: від рекрутингу до фінансів та юридичних питань.

- Спільнота фаундерів, які вже запустили не один бізнес й можуть ділитися практичним досвідом.

- Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: маркетинг, розробка, фінанси, рекрутинг.

- Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій.

- Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар та психолог.

Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

 

THE ROLE

As the first point of contact for our Technical Support team, the Customer Services Specialist will orchestrate the flow of inbound inquiries to ensure our global customers receive immediate, world-class assistance. You will bridge the gap between complex technical issues and rapid resolution by strategically routing requests and managing the lifecycle of support tickets. By collaborating closely with Support Engineers and Managers, you ensure that every Everpure customer feels heard and supported during critical moments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Orchestrate Incident Flow: Direct all incoming support requests across phone, email, and the Everpure portal to the appropriate engineers, ensuring high-priority issues are addressed immediately to minimize customer downtime.

• Manage Lifecycle Communications: Drive customer satisfaction by providing proactive status updates on open tickets, ensuring transparency and setting clear expectations for resolution timelines.

• Monitor Service Health: Audit the support queue by severity and priority to ensure no case falls behind, escalating critical or aging issues to Support Leadership to maintain our stringent Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Drive Operational Intelligence: Perform targeted statistical analysis on recurring support trends to help the engineering team identify root causes and improve the long-term stability of the Everpure Platform.

title: Software Engineer and Security Researcher
description:
Description
We're hiring a Software Engineer and Security Researcher to help build our top-tier cybersecurity product. This is a hybrid role by design: a strong software engineer who also brings a deep cybersecurity background. Strong engineering velocity is how features get shipped; serious security expertise is how those features get shipped right. You should have an understanding of how attackers and defenders actually operate. The product space is CSPM/CNAPP-related, but extends beyond it. Expect to work across cloud posture, identity, attack paths, prioritization, detection, and adjacent areas as the product evolves. The pace is high. AI is part of how we work, every day.
Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and ship product features end-to-end: from security research to architecture and production code to release.

• Apply cybersecurity expertise to every feature decision: what to detect, how to model risk, what makes a finding actionable, where customers will be misled by noise, and howto translate raw cloud signal into something a security team can trust and act on.

• Own cloud security capabilities across CSPM and beyond: posture, identity, attack paths, severity/prioritization, detections, and emerging areas of the platform.

• Drive AI into the development loop. Use coding agents and LLM tools as a core part of how you design, prototype, build, debug, review, and document. Write strong prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and turn AI-generated work into production-quality code and logic.

• Move fast, with judgment. Make tradeoffs explicit, ship iteratively, and learn from real customer signals.

• Collaborate closely with product, research, and engineering peers: clear written specs, sharp communication, clean handoffs, customer-facing rationale.

Requirements
Requirements:

• 5+ years as a software engineer. You design systems, write production code, reason about reliability and edge cases, and own delivery end-to-end.

• Strong cybersecurity foundation. You understand threats, controls, identity, cloud risk, and why a “finding” is or isn’t worth a customer’s attention. This is what makes your feature decisions land.

• Hands-on experience developing with AI / AI-driven development. This is a MUST.

• You have meaningfully shipped work where coding agents, LLM tools, or in-IDE AI assistants were a core part of how you built it. You can speak in detail about what worked, what didn’t, and how you got real leverage out of these tools.

• Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP also valid).

• Comfortable operating at high pace: small batches, fast iteration, willingness to cut scope to ship, calm under pressure.

• Strong communication: you can explain engineering and security tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

• Experience building CSPM/CNAPP products, cloud security detection/analytics pipelines, or other top-tier security products.

• Experience building or fine-tuning AI-powered developer workflows: custom agents, pipelines, evals, internal AI tooling, prompt frameworks.

• Familiarity with cloud telemetry/log sources and correlating security signals across configuration, identity, and activity.

• Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform) and cloud-native development experience.

• Prior security research background: vulnerability research, threat research, or detection engineering.

description:
About Teamified :
Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.
About the client:
Our client is an innovative Australian health technology company developing an AI-powered anxiety coaching application based on an evidence-based psychological approach to managing anxiety.
The application is designed for iOS and Android using React Native, with a React-based website supporting user registration and subscriptions. Currently in the testing phase and approaching its soft launch, the platform features an AI-powered coaching assistant that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver structured, personalised coaching conversations.
The AI Coach operates within a clinically guided framework, incorporating structured coaching pathways, a toolkit of resources, conversational guidelines, and built-in safety mechanisms that can intervene when necessary.
As the platform handles sensitive mental health information, security, privacy, and responsible AI development are central to its design and ongoing operation.
About the role:
We are hiring one person to own the product's engineering end-to-end. You will be the technical owner of the AI Coach and the systems around it, reporting directly to a non-technical founder. You plan your own work, set your own technical direction within the product brief, and ship. There is no CTO above you and no agency to lean on - you are the engineering function, working at speed with AI-first tooling and agentic coding workflows.

• Own the AI Coach: prompting, conversation state and progression, retrieval (Pinecone), model selection and evaluation, and the safety/crisis layer - tested against scripted clinical scenarios

• Own the backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry), SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, AWS (Sydney)

• Own mobile and web delivery: React Native (iOS + Android) and React, including App Store / Google Play / Stripe subscriptions

• Own release engineering: CI/CD, environments, signing credentials, monitoring, backups, rollback - built for fast, safe, frequent releases

• Bring a product eye: you care how screens look and feel on mobile and web, not just whether the API returns 200

• Translate technical decisions into plain language for the founder and clinical team

How you work (this is the core of the role):
You are an AI-first engineer. You use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code or equivalent) as your default workflow - planning, generating, reviewing and shipping with AI leverage rather than writing everything by hand. You build evaluation harnesses so the AI Coach can be tested automatically against scenario suites on every change. You are a self-starter who takes a brief, breaks it into a plan, communicates the plan, executes it, and reports outcomes - with direction from the founder but without needing technical supervision.

• Plan -> Approve -> Deliver: you propose the plan, get sign-off on direction, and own execution

• Comfortable being the only engineer initially: you learn the system from the code (there is limited as-built documentation) and make it yours

• Bias to shipping: small, frequent, reversible releases with monitoring and rollback in place

• Judgement over heroics: this is a mental health product - safety thresholds and crisis handling are governed by legal and clinical sign-off, and you build the systems that enforce them

Requirements
What we're looking for:

• Proven experience shipping LLM-based products to production: prompt architecture

As our Accounts Payable Analyst, you will manage the full payables cycle from invoice intake and three-way matching to payment runs, vendor reconciliations, and month-end close.
This is more than processing. You will be the person who spots the coding error before it distorts job costs, who reconciles the vendor statement nobody else wants to touch, and who tells us what our spend is doing. As the business grows, you will help build the payables process that scales with it.
What You'll Do

• Process the payables volume. Review, code, and enter high volumes of vendor invoices, matching to purchase orders and receiving documentation and resolving discrepancies before they hit the ledger.

Investigate and resolve credit card transaction discrepancies, disputed charges, and unapplied credits with vendors and card-issuing banks.

• 5+ years of accounts payable experience, including full cycle, high volume processing

• Hands on experience with purchase order based invoicing and three-way match

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Blockchain Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Blockchain Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $140,000-$200,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Blockchain Developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade decentralized applications (dApps), smart contract platforms, and blockchain-integrated backend services supporting financial services, digital asset management, and enterprise transaction processing. This role focuses on building secure, scalable blockchain solutions that integrate seamlessly with cloud-native microservices and traditional enterprise applications.
You will work closely with solution architects, security engineers, DevOps teams, and product owners to develop smart contracts, blockchain APIs, digital wallet integrations, tokenization platforms, and secure transaction processing systems. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in blockchain protocols, smart contract development, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure while maintaining strong software engineering fundamentals.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop secure smart contracts for enterprise blockchain applications using Solidity or other smart contract languages.

• Build scalable backend services that interact with blockchain networks for transaction processing, asset management, and identity verification.

• Develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs to expose blockchain functionality to web and mobile applications.

• Design blockchain data models, token standards, and transaction workflows for high-volume enterprise systems.

• Integrate enterprise applications with Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, or other blockchain platforms.

• Develop secure wallet integrations, digital signature workflows, and key management solutions.

• Implement blockchain event listeners, indexing services, and off-chain processing components.

• Build scalable microservices using .NET Core, Java, or Node.js that interact with blockchain networks.

• Optimize smart contracts for gas efficiency, scalability, and transaction throughput.

• Perform smart contract audits, security testing, and vulnerability assessments before production deployments.

• Collaborate with DevOps teams to deploy blockchain infrastructure across Azure or AWS cloud environments.

• Participate in architectural reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and production support activities.

• Troubleshoot complex blockchain network issues, transaction failures, synchronization problems, and production incidents.

Required Skills

• Six or more years of professional software development experience building enterprise-grade distributed applications.

• Three or more years of hands-on blockchain development experience delivering production blockchain solutions.

• Strong experience developing smart contracts using Solidity and Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)-compatible networks.

• Hands-on experience with blockchain platforms such as Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, Binance Smart Chain, or Quorum.

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js or backend development using C#/.NET Core or Java.

• Experience building decentralized applications (dApps) with React, Angular, or Vue.js.

• Strong understanding of blockchain architecture, consensus algorithms, cryptographic hashing, digital signatures, Merkle trees, and distributed ledger concepts.

title: CDI - Chef de projets multitechniques F/H
description:
La Plenitude Aréna est la plus grande enceinte d’Europe qui accueille des concerts, des spectacles, des événements spéciaux et des événements sportifs, dont les matchs du Racing 92.
Ultra moderne et innovante, la Plenitude Aréna se caractérise par une modularité exceptionnelle et un accueil de qualité de ses clients, prestataires et collaborateurs.
Depuis son inauguration en octobre 2017 avec les Rolling Stones, la Plenitude Aréna a significativement augmenté le nombre d’événements accueillis chaque saison et a pris soin de se diversifier.
Vos missions
Votre mission :
Au sein de la Plenitude Aréna, Le Chef de projet multitechnique assure le pilotage de la maintenance et de l’exploitation technique portant sur l’ensemble des installations du site.
Il veille à la disponibilité, à la performance, à la sécurité et à la conformité des équipements, tout en garantissant la continuité d’activité et la bonne tenue des événements ou opérations organisés sur le site.
Missions principales

Piloter la maintenance et l’exploitation multitechnique

Piloter la maintenance préventive, corrective et améliorative des équipements et installations techniques.
Garantir la disponibilité et le bon fonctionnement des installations : électricité, courants faibles, CVC, plomberie, équipements de sécurité, automatismes, éclairage et équipements spécifiques au site.
Planifier les interventions en tenant compte des contraintes d’exploitation et du calendrier événementiel.
Analyser les incidents, identifier leurs causes et coordonner la mise en œuvre des actions correctives.
Proposer des solutions d’amélioration visant à renforcer la fiabilité, la performance et la durée de vie des équipements.
Piloter et mettre à jour les outils de GMAO.
Veiller à la qualité et à la traçabilité des interventions réalisées.

title: Partner (m/w/d) für S/4HANA
description:
Wir sind Skandinaviens erfolgreichste Unternehmensberatung mit mehr als 1700 Berater:innen, einer einzigartigen Unternehmenskultur und einer expandierenden Basis in Deutschland. Nach anhaltend starkem Wachstum in Dänemark, Schweden, Norwegen und der Schweiz bauen wir unsere Präsenz in Deutschland weiter aus.
Wir helfen Menschen und Organisationen, sich den Herausforderungen der Zukunft zu stellen, und begleiten sie bei ihren Veränderungsprozessen. Zum Erreichen der bestmöglichen Ergebnisse kombinieren wir analytisches Denken und intuitives Verständnis. Wir verknüpfen die neuesten Theorien mit Sensibilität für Menschen und Organisationsdynamik. Nicht zuletzt beziehen wir aktiv die Menschen mit ein, die in die Veränderungsprozesse involviert sind - wir nennen das „Collaborative Consulting“. Seit 25 Jahren schaffen wir mit unserem Ansatz positive Veränderungen.
Unsere Projekte sind breit gefächert und decken die komplette Wertschöpfungskette in den Bereichen Life Sciences/Health Care, Retail/FMCG, Industrials sowie im Service-Sektor ab.

• Du begleitest Kunden von der Strategiekonzeption bis hin zur Umsetzung und kommunizierst dabei auf C-Level-Ebene. Du agierst dabei als Client Advisor und arbeitest auch mit Systemintegratoren zusammen.

Wir sind auf der Suche nach Menschen, die

• authentisch sind und es verstehen, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufzubauen und auf Augenhöhe respektvoll auf allen Hierarchieebenen zu kommunizieren

• wahre People Leader sind und ein engagiertes, leidenschaftliches Team coachen und weiterentwickeln

title: Quality Engineer
description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need-and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework - be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

• Explorer (Level 1) - Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

• Builder (Level 2) - Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

• Integrator (Level 3) - Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role
You’ll help ensure our software is developed, released, and maintained in line with quality standards and regulatory requirements. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and regulatory teams to keep compliance practical and embedded in day-to-day delivery.
What you’ll be doing

• Manage and coordinate software releases, including release readiness checks, approvals, and release records

• Create and maintain technical documentation (e.g., software requirements, verification and validation records, traceability matrices, risk files)

• Support software lifecycle processes in line with standards such as IEC 62304 and ISO 13485

• Review change requests, bug reports, and deviations, and assess their quality and regulatory impact

• Contribute to risk management activities (ISO 14971)

• Support internal and external audits, CAPAs, and process improvements

• Promote quality best practices within development teams

What you need to have

• -3 years of experience in software quality, QA, or a regulated environment

• Hands-on experience with release management and technical documentation

• Familiarity with quality management systems and regulated software

• Understanding of the software development lifecycle and CI/CD concepts

• Strong attention to detail and clear written communication

• Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling - once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

title: Senior Director, AP Test Publishing
description:
Senior Director, AP Test Publishing
College Board - Advanced Placement & Instruction
Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.
Role Type : This is a full-time position
About the Team
The College Board ’s Advanced Placement and Instruction division (300+ staff) develops and administers coursework taken by more than 3 million students worldwide each school year, and the related subject-matter exams utilized by more than 4,000 colleges and universities for course placement and awarding of college credit. These include credit and placement examination programs like CLEP and ACCUplacer; Advanced Placement (AP) and Pre-AP courses in 40+ disciplines; and associated teacher professional learning programs.
The AP Test Publishing team manages the production of print materials for AP exams worldwide. In collaboration with College Board Operations and vendors, the team produces accommodated print, large print, Braille, and hybrid free response booklets - ensuring equitable, high-quality access for students requiring alternate formats.
About the Opportunity
The Senior Director, AP Test Publishing will collaborate with key organizational workstreams on the build and execution of requirements and processes for the evolving print exam needs of the AP program. This will require defining the development needs and requirements to build print exams in alignment with the current AP course and exam change roadmap. This role oversees content change alignment, planning, and execution for exam publishing and print needs with external vendors, maintaining and communicating detailed documentation and reporting across various interdependent workstreams led by a number of internal and external teams.
In this role, you will:
LEAD & MANAGE THE AP TEST PUBLISHING TEAM (10%)

• Lead a team of two team members that is responsible for the annual production of print exam materials.

• Set vision and priorities for the team, track and mange progress to goals, and provide coaching and support to ensure team members meet and exceed goals, remain engaged, and contribute meaningfully to our mission

• Cultivate an inclusive and high achieving culture that enables all team members to live out College Board ’s Operating Principles.

• Bring proven leadership experience and consistently embody College Board ’s Manager Expectations in your work.
TEST PUBLISHING GOVERNANCE & ARCHITECTURE (25%)

• Own the enterprise Test Publishing operating model, including governance architecture, decision rights, and escalation structure, that enables consistent, scalable execution as the AP program insources assessment production and expands its internally owned exam portfolio.

• Serve as system integrator and Tier 2 decision authority, adjudicating cross-portfolio tradeoffs across scope, timeline, quality, and cost. Steward material cross-subject and governance risks and resolve escalations that cannot be settled at the Director level.

• Define, publish, and evolve enterprise Test Publishing standards and frameworks, QC architecture, workflow guardrails, and escalation models, grounded in retrospective data, to drive process integrity and reduce recurring cross-portfolio failure points.
PORTFOLIO DELIVERY & VENDOR OVERSIGHT (25%)

• Direct sustained delivery of all internally owned AP print, accommodated, and Braille publishing commitments at full scale. Hold milestone integrity and portfolio readiness through delegated project-management and vendor-systems leads while retaining accountability for outcomes.

• Own senior-level external alignment and vendor governance with print and production vendors, including SLA and performance oversight, contract-level escalation, and quality-control accountability, as the sustained operating relationship supporting insourced production.

You will support projects tied to People team tooling, employee data, and compliance, working closely with People Partners, Payroll, Legal, IT, and Internal Tools. You will work across Workday, Greenhouse, and Checkr, and your attention to detail and commitment to process improvement will keep employee data accurate and employee experiences smooth.
Onboarding - Own day-to-day onboarding execution for large new hire cohorts: coordinate start dates, communicate with incoming employees, and keep the onboarding experience organized - Work alongside existing team members to handle volume and cover for each other as weekly onboarding is adopted
Contingent Worker Onboarding - Collect required information, initiate background checks, send welcome communications, and coordinate start dates with managers
Conversions and Status Changes - Process full-time to part-time conversions, contractor modifications, and vendor communications
HRIS Administration - Maintain employee records in Workday, process status changes and updates, and ensure data accuracy across systems - Partner with People Partners and managers when employee records need to be updated or corrected
People Tickets and Documentation - Triage and respond to internal employee questions and requests, and maintain the people tickets queue - Build and maintain onboarding guides, process playbooks, and FAQs so employees and the team can find what they need
Qualifications -

• 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR operations, or HRIS administration

• Experience at other tech companies, ideally fast-growing organizations

• Workday (HRIS) experience strongly recommended; Greenhouse or similar HR systems experience a plus

• Organized and detail-oriented, with excellent professional judgment when managing time-sensitive processes related to compensation, performance, and compliance

• Careful handling of employee data, with a firm commitment to accuracy and privacy

• Reliable and responsive when fielding urgent questions from employees and People team partners

• Excellent communication skills for coordinating with cross-functional partners

• Able to manage multiple deadlines and prioritize effectively as priorities shift

• Customer service oriented, treating internal teams as clients, with a flexible and creative approach to problem-solving

• Comfortable working as part of a small team, collaborating daily on onboarding and tickets and supporting each other during busy periods

Additional Information

• Contract, approximately 6 months

• Full time, 40 hours per week.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Sales & Business Administrator | UK hours
description:
About the Role
Our client in the UK is looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Administrator to support the sales team and director of a growing business. This role will focus on sales administration, order processing, inbox and diary management, and coordinating with suppliers and vendors to ensure day-to-day operations run smoothly.
The ideal candidate has experience in sales or business administration, is confident using Microsoft 365 and CRM systems, and can manage multiple tasks accurately and efficiently.
Responsibilities

• Provide administrative support to the sales team and director.

• Manage inboxes and diaries, ensuring tasks and schedules are organised.

• Prepare and process quotes, orders, purchase orders and invoices accurately.

• Follow up on outstanding purchase orders and coordinate with suppliers and vendors.

• Manage vendor programme administration and related documentation.

• Maintain accurate records and update information across relevant systems.

• Use Microsoft 365, including Outlook and Excel, to support daily administrative tasks.

Requirements

• At least 3 years of experience in sales administration, order processing, executive assistance or office administration.

• Experience supporting a sales team or director directly.

• Strong Microsoft 365 skills, particularly Outlook and Excel.

• Confident using CRM systems and handling quoting and order processing.

• Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and ensure work is completed accurately and on time.

• Experience in IT, distribution or B2B supply would be advantageous.

• Exposure to education or public sector procurement would be a plus.

title: Video Content Creator / Créateur de contenu vidéo
description:
LANDR is a fast-growing audio company made up of left-brained creative technologists, right-brained music professionals and everyone in between. Together, we are revolutionizing the process for music makers to help them create, master, distribute and promote their music.
We love music. We love musicians. Our mission is to give music makers the freedom to create and be heard. We bring our love of music to work every day and we are continuously innovating to create experiences that delight and engage our audience of over 6 million music creators.
We're looking for a Video Content Creator to make engaging content for LANDR 's social media. You’ll film and edit, and also be one of the faces and voices of the content! We are looking for someone to bring a pop culture instinct, a working knowledge of music production, and the ability to explain things the way a friend would, not the way a brand would.
This is a 6-month contract, with the possibility of extension, focused on growing our reach with emerging artists and music creators. This position is remote and open to candidates regardless of location.
Before you apply: we ask all candidates to submit a short test video. You'll find the instructions at the bottom of this posting.
What you'll do

• Create and feature on short-form vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram, YT Shorts, etc.

• Create and feature on long-form video walkthroughs

• Pitch video ideas rooted in what's happening in music and pop culture right now, including trends, sounds, releases, and conversations artists are having

• Write or adapt your own scripts and hooks, keeping them tight, jargon-free, and native to each platform

• Collaborate with our social, design, and video teams, on shoot planning and editing notes

• Review performance with the Organic team at LANDR , and use what works to shape the next round of content

• Stay on top of platform trends and formats, and bring new ideas to test

What we're looking for

• On-camera experience as a creator, host, or presenter, with a portfolio or channel we can look at

• A strong, natural presence on camera. You can hold attention in the first three seconds and keep it

• A working knowledge of music production and the modern artist workflow (DAWs, mixing and mastering basics, releasing music independently)

• A sharp ear for pop culture and a real feel for what's resonating with young music creators

• Fluency in TikTok and Instagram Reels culture: hooks, pacing, trends, and what makes people stop scrolling

• The ability to simplify technical ideas without dumbing them down

• Excellent spoken and written English

How to apply: the test

• Along with your application, please submit a short test video.

• Deliverable: one 30-45 second vertical video, in English, in the style of " LANDR Can Do That?", a format built around one underused feature and the one artist problem it solves.

• Pick something from landr.com you find interesting or useful (distribution royalty splits, free mastering, the plugin bundle, whatever) and explain it to the camera the way you'd tell a friend about a hack you just found, not the way a brand would pitch it. Hook in the first three seconds, one feature only, no jargon.

• A phone camera is fine. Send it as a link (unlisted YouTube, Google Drive, whatever's easiest) or as file below.
